purpose: Diagnose BLACK service, WSL systemd user-session warning, process ownership, and Windows interop after reboot. Read-only diagnostic.
command:
set +e
echo '===IDENTITY==='
id
printf 'HOME=%s USER=%s\n' "$HOME" "$USER"
echo '===WSL==='
uname -a
printf 'WSL_DISTRO_NAME=%s WSL_INTEROP=%s\n' "$WSL_DISTRO_NAME" "$WSL_INTEROP"
cat /etc/wsl.conf 2>/dev/null || true
echo '===SYSTEM_SERVICE==='
systemctl is-enabled amx-black.service 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-active amx-black.service 2>&1 || true
systemctl status amx-black.service --no-pager -n 25 2>&1 || true
echo '===USER_MANAGER==='
systemctl --user is-system-running 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user is-enabled amx-black.service 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user is-active amx-black.service 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user status amx-black.service --no-pager -n 25 2>&1 || true
loginctl show-user amx -p State -p Linger -p RuntimePath -p Sessions 2>&1 || true
echo '===PROCESSES==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,lstart,args | grep -E 'BLACK/worker.py|amx-black|python3' | grep -v grep || true
echo '===WINDOWS_INTEROP==='
command -v powershell.exe || true
test -x /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe && echo POWERSHELL_PATH_PRESENT || echo POWERSHELL_PATH_MISSING
cat /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/WSLInterop 2>/dev/null || true
echo '===MOUNTS==='
mount | grep -E ' /mnt/c |drvfs' || true
echo '===DONE==='
